title.en: Factories (Registration and Other Services — Fees and Forms) Regulations

completenessNote: 全文，共 15 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 3 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。其中 2 条为官方正文中标注的已废止条文存根（照录）。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Factories (Registration and Other Services — Fees and Forms) Regulations.
4. The fees to be paid in respect of special services shall be in accordance with Part II of the First Schedule.

heading.en: Fee for approval of third party inspection agency

text.en:
4A. The fee to be paid in respect of the approval of an organisation as a third party inspection agency or the renewal of such approval shall be $180.
[S 53/2002 wef 01/02/2002]

heading.en: Fee for registration as approved scaffold contractor

text.en:
4B. The fee to be paid in respect of the registration as an approved scaffold contractor under the Factories (Scaffolds) Regulations 2004 (G.N. No. S 19/2004) or the renewal of a certificate of registration shall be $150.
[S 762/2004 wef 02/01/2005]

heading.en: Fee for approval of crane contractor

text.en:
4C. The fee to be paid in respect of the approval of an organisation as an approved crane contractor under the Factories (Operation of Cranes) Regulations (Rg 10) or the renewal of such approval shall be $150.
[S 762/2004 wef 02/01/2005]

heading.en: Fee for approval of approved person or authorised boiler inspector

text.en:
4D.—(1) The fee to be paid in respect of the approval of an approved person or authorised boiler inspector shall be $250.
(2) The fee to be paid in respect of the renewal of such approval shall be $60.
(3) Paragraphs (1) and (2) shall not apply to any factory inspector appointed under section 84 of the Act.
[S 762/2004 wef 02/01/2005]
6. Regulations 3 and 4 shall not apply to any department of the Government.

7. The reports or certificates, as the case may be, on steam boilers, superheaters, economisers, steam receivers, cast-iron underfired vulcanisers, air receivers, refrigerating plant pressure receivers, hoists, lifts, lifting gear, lifting appliances and lifting machines shall be in the forms set out in the Second Schedule.
8. The form of notice requiring any person to attend court referred to in section 88(4) of the Act shall be as set out in the Third Schedule.
